notes: GeoTalk 3.3.0: NEW — real WebRTC internet voice calls. Voice goes directly phone-to-phone first for the lowest delay; if a network blocks the direct path, the same call automatically relays through Cloudflare TURN (UDP, TCP and TLS on port 443) — no failed calls while you have internet. Push-to-Talk stays as the final fallback. Also included: internet and Bluetooth chat + voice calls, Random Chat, voice messages and in-app updates. The app is now about 18 MB because it carries the WebRTC engine.
